The '''Borosk system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]]. It was the place of a [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|decisive battle]] between the forces of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
